# 🤖 2Captcha

> **Category**: `CAPTCHA Solvers`  
> **Official Vendor API Docs**: [https://2captcha.com/api-docs](https://2captcha.com/api-docs)

Human-powered and AI-first CAPTCHA recognition service supporting reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, and image captchas.
